description: Light and zesty, perfect for a healthy dinner.
steps: Pat salmon dry and season with olive oil, lemon zest, parsley, salt, and pepper.|Sear skin-side down until crisp, then finish gently until flaky.|Plate with steamed greens and fresh lemon wedges.

description: Quick and protein-packed with crisp vegetables.
steps: Saute chicken until golden and just cooked through.|Add broccoli and peppers with ginger-garlic sauce.|Serve over rice and finish with sesame seeds.

description: Hearty and nutritious with a light citrus finish.
steps: Layer quinoa with spinach, zucchini, and chickpeas.|Spoon over lemon tahini and finish with herbs.|Serve warm or chilled for meal prep.

description: Easy and satisfying lunch built for busy afternoons.
steps: Spread avocado across the wrap and layer turkey and vegetables.|Roll tightly and slice in half.|Pair with fruit or crunchy vegetables.

description: Fresh and veggie-filled comfort in one bowl.
steps: Cook pasta until al dente and reserve a splash of pasta water.|Saute vegetables until tender-crisp.|Toss everything together with parmesan and herbs.

description: Hydrating and energizing, perfect for a warm day.
steps: Combine quinoa, cucumber, chickpeas, and mint in a large bowl.|Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil, then top with cherry tomatoes and toss gently.

description: Refreshing, protein-forward breakfast with fruit and crunch.
steps: Layer yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass.|Top with chia seeds and a light honey drizzle.|Serve chilled for a quick balanced breakfast.

description: Small but satisfying snack for a quick lift between meals.
steps: Mix oats, peanut butter, and chopped dates until combined.|Fold in flax and a few chocolate chips.|Roll into bite-sized pieces and chill briefly before serving.

description: Layered vegetables with a slower oven finish and deeper flavor.
steps: Slice vegetables evenly and layer over herbed tomato sauce.|Brush lightly with olive oil and bake until tender.|Rest briefly before serving so the layers hold together.

description: Comforting, hearty, and easy to batch for the week.
steps: Roast tomatoes and garlic until softened and fragrant.|Simmer with lentils and stock until the soup turns rich and silky.|Blend lightly and finish with basil before serving.

description: Bright, briny, and filling enough for an easy lunch.
steps: Toss chopped vegetables with chickpeas and olives.|Add feta and herbs.|Dress lightly with lemon and olive oil.

description: Leafy, crisp, and lifted with orange and seeds.
steps: Massage kale with dressing.|Top with orange segments and seeds.|Finish with parmesan just before serving.

description: Smoky chicken, crisp romaine, and creamy avocado.
steps: Slice cooked chicken.|Layer over romaine with beans and corn.|Top with avocado and lime dressing.

description: A chilled pasta option with tomatoes, basil, and mozzarella.
steps: Toss cooled pasta with tomatoes and mozzarella.|Add basil and olive oil.|Chill briefly before serving.

description: Fast tofu, rice, and vegetables with a sweet-savory glaze.
steps: Sear tofu until golden.|Cook vegetables until crisp-tender.|Serve over rice with teriyaki glaze.

description: Tender salmon over rice with crunchy cucumber and cabbage.
steps: Roast or sear salmon until flaky.|Build the bowl with rice and vegetables.|Finish with sesame dressing.

description: Beans, rice, roasted corn, and avocado in one filling bowl.
steps: Warm rice and beans.|Add corn and avocado.|Top with salsa and herbs.

description: Herby dressing, greens, and grains with a creamy finish.
steps: Cook grains and cool slightly.|Layer with greens and cucumber.|Finish with herb dressing.

description: Light broth with tofu, greens, and umami depth.
steps: Warm broth gently.|Add tofu and vegetables.|Stir in miso off heat.

description: Comforting broth with vegetables and tender chicken.
steps: Simmer chicken and vegetables.|Add noodles near the end.|Finish with herbs.

description: Silky coconut broth with vegetables and warm spice.
steps: Saute aromatics.|Simmer with broth and vegetables.|Finish with coconut milk.

description: Tomato broth, beans, vegetables, and pasta in one pot.
steps: Simmer vegetables in tomato broth.|Add beans and pasta.|Cook until tender and finish with herbs.

description: Creamy but fresh pasta with wilted greens.
steps: Cook pasta until al dente.|Stir ricotta with a splash of pasta water.|Fold in spinach and parmesan.

description: Bright basil pesto with peas for a quick weeknight dinner.
steps: Cook pasta and peas together.|Toss with pesto and parmesan.|Finish with lemon zest.

description: Cold noodles with crunchy vegetables and a savory sauce.
steps: Cook and cool noodles.|Toss with vegetables and sauce.|Top with scallions before serving.
